timeline.description: Written answer reports an interdepartmental exploration by the Digitale Doetank into an independent AI safety institute, modelled on the UK institute, running until September 2026.
timeline.short: Cabinet confirms an interdepartmental exploration of an independent AI safety institute.

timeline.description: Study of the option, commissioned by the economy ministry from TNO, published; exploration under way by this date
timeline.short: Ministry-commissioned TNO study of an AI safety institute option is published.

timeline.description: International AI Strategy reaffirms exploration of the desirability and feasibility of a Dutch AI safety institute, taking account of existing advisory bodies.
timeline.short: International AI Strategy reaffirms exploration of a Dutch AI safety institute.

timeline.description: Cabinet letter to parliament: an exploration of an AI safety institute is under way; the advisory report will be shared with parliament by the end of 2026.
timeline.short: Cabinet says AI safety institute exploration under way; report due year end.
timeline.news: The cabinet tells parliament it is exploring whether to set up an AI safety institute, and that an advisory report will follow by the end of 2026.

record.identifier_notes: Q55 is the constituent Netherlands, matching tracker population and European country scope. Q29999 is Kingdom of the Netherlands and holds current Wikidata ISO-code statements. ISO3/M49 are independently verified in the UN table; do not equate both entities.

claims.text: Motion 37020 no. 49 asks the government to set up an AI safety institute in close cooperation with similar institutes in Germany, France and England.
The House of Representatives' vote record marks motion 37020 no. 49 as adopted.
The International AI Strategy says the Netherlands will also seek to join the International Network for Advanced AI Measurement, Evaluation and Science.
The French presidency lists the Netherlands among the heads of state and government who signed the Paris Call declaration on 9 November 2026.
The cabinet's AI vision says it is also investigating the possible establishment of a Dutch AI safety institute that could help recognise and address new risks in time.

record.summary: Exploring since 1 June 2026: Cabinet confirms an interdepartmental exploration of an independent AI safety institute.
